title: Reading Drill — Testing boat landing signs — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing boat landing signs — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The harbour patrol in Hillswick received an old report about rowers missing the direction sign during low tides. The report compared the number of missed turns, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the marker buoys rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered seven weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include strong reflections. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a second sign pointing upriver as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
